final_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Create one new original KeepXClean app icon. Square 1024-by-1024 composition, opaque artwork.
The background is a completely uniform pure white canvas. Center a flat, solid pale mint #EAF6EF rounded square filling 96 percent of the canvas width and height. Corner radius is 22 percent of tile width. The mint tile has ONE perfectly uniform color from edge to edge, with no texture, shading, gradient, bevel, glow, vignette, shadow or transparency. Outside its rounded corners is pure white.
The central mark is a bold, distinctive custom capital K for Keep. Strong vertical rectangular stem on the left, two thick diagonal arms on the right. A slender but clearly visible mint vertical channel separates the upright stem from the two connected right arms. The right arms meet as a broad left-pointing chevron. Together, the two pieces unmistakably form a capital K. Use gently softened exterior corners and precise straight internal cuts. Keep the geometry simple and beautiful, balanced and legible as a 16-pixel browser toolbar icon. Overall K width about 58 percent and height 60 percent of the tile.
The K alone has very restrained near-black titanium material, charcoal #171B1A faces and a subtle narrow gray highlight along its upper edges. No heavy 3D extrusion, no cast shadow. Orthographic straight-on view.
This is a clean final icon asset, not a scene, not a mockup, not a presentation sheet. No labels, no words, no smaller icon previews. The K is the only mark.
Original independent brand identity, not any existing social platform logo. No X symbol or crossed diagonals; no bird, shield, protective circle, ring, arc, star, sparkle, checkmark, badge, noise, dirt, clouds or checkerboard.
Everything is opaque, including the entire mint tile and the white corner areas.
